newsitem.title: TURKEY: Turk domestic debt up to 2,891 trln lira end-Oct.
newsitem.headline: Turk domestic debt up to 2,891 trln lira end-Oct.

text.p: Turkey's outstanding domestic debt rose to 2,891 trillion lira at end-October from 2,735 trillion lira at end-September, and compared to 2,184 trillion lira in the first half of 1996, the Treasury said on Thursday.

It said 10-month domestic debt comprised 1,876 trillion lira Treasury-bills with less than one-year maturities, 850.23 trillion lira of government bonds at least one-year maturities and 164.65 trillion lira of central bank advances.
Turkey's domestic debt was 1,361 trillion lira at end-1995. --Istanbul newsroom +90-212-275 08 75 ATA
